type:
@Roth.degreeOf_rename_mul_aeval : ∀ {τ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  (U : MvPolynomial τ R) {V : Polynomial R},
  V ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (j : τ),
      MvPolynomial.degreeOf (some j) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) U * (Polynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X none)) V) =
        MvPolynomial.degreeOf j U
what: Multiplication by a nonzero univariate factor in a disjoint variable preserves every old-variable partial degree, allowing the other factor to be zero.
how: Split U=0; use degreeOf_mul_eq, injective rename preservation and singleton-renaming normalization to show the other factor contributes zero.

explicit_call_sites.pattern: rw [← degreeOf_rename_mul_aeval U hV j, ← hFUV]

moral_duplications: Product-degree additivity plus injective renaming are existing mathlib facts.
Analogous none-variable theorem is distinct because its RHS is V.natDegree.
generalization: CommSemiring R + NoZeroDivisors R complete proof compiled; arbitrary-degree-zero-factor principle compiled separately; hV and nonannihilation guards compiled. NoZeroDivisors is a sufficient global condition; weakest point-local nonannihilation alternatives are not claimed.
missing_api: Design choice between degree preservation under multiplication by a nonzero zero-degree factor and degree zero outside the range of a renaming. No global absence claim.
junk: Not junk: one explicit project use and one direct kernel-value consumer.
action: Keep local while deciding three upstream API questions; semiring weakening verified; sole caller can inline accepted derivation without changing original interface.
